messages:
evan: FYI OrbitChain listing goes GA Friday. Need short partner SEV handoff + rollback owner. Propose private channel + one pager.

kim: I can do bridge-runner first 48h. channel name: #partners-orbitchain-sev-private.

marco: +1 private channel. Roles: bridge-runner, partner-liaison, rollback-exec, comms-owner.

olga (partner): OrbitChain L2 reachable via Slack (olga_orbit) and phone +1-555-321-9000. We'll join war room if P-SEV1.

ops-bot: Channel template ready: pinned runbook, rollback.md, contacts.md, postmortem-template. Auto-invite: marketplace-ops, infra-oncall, partner-success.

marco: Quick SEV snippet:
P-SEV1: open war-room -> @bridge-runner -> invite infra-oncall + OrbitChain L2 -> 0-15m triage -> decision at T+30m (rollback exec runs if blocking).

kim: Rollback exec = marketplace-ops oncall. I'll add step commands to rollback.md.

olga (partner): OrbitChain can approve rollback recommendation; Redwood must execute listing rollback. We'll sign authority addendum before GA.

evan: PR/comms: any customer-impact SEV triggers PR notify within 45m. @marketplace-ops please confirm rollback test in staging tomorrow 09:00 PT.

marketplace-ops: Confirmed, staging rollback test scheduled 09:00 PT. Channel created: #partners-orbitchain-sev-private. Invites sent.

marco: I'll run a 10min tabletop tomorrow 10:30 PT in the channel. Drill: escalate to P-SEV1 and run rollback checklist.

evan: Perfect. Upload signed rollback authority and contact cards to pinned contacts.md before EOD Thursday. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
